instruction: Draw a square with side length 20 centered at (0, 10). Draw a vertical construction line at x = 0 from y = -5 to y = 30. Connect the square upper-right corners to a point at (0, 26) to form a half house outline. Do mirror to form this house. Finally draw a circle of radius 4 at the origin. The two roof edges must be equal length and symmetric about x = 0. Save the completed model to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd.
